---
title: "Install"
---

## From an existing Quarto project

```sh
quarto add tiagojct/pequod-quarto
```

This drops the extension under `_extensions/tiagojct/pequod/` and
`_extensions/tiagojct/pequod-dark/`. Quarto's resolver honours the
org-prefixed install path automatically.

## Scaffold a new deck from the template

```sh
quarto use template tiagojct/pequod-quarto
```

You land on a minimal `template.qmd` already configured for
`pequod-revealjs`.

## Pin a version

Releases are tagged. Pin in CI or for reproducibility:

```sh
quarto add tiagojct/pequod-quarto@v0.3.0
```

Check the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/tiagojct/pequod-quarto/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for what each release adds.

## Update

```sh
quarto update tiagojct/pequod-quarto
```

## Uninstall

```sh
quarto remove tiagojct/pequod-quarto
```

## Known issues

::: {.callout-warning}
**Single-file render under org-prefixed install.** Quarto's resolver
has a known bug where
`quarto render subdir/chapter.qmd --to pequod-html` may fail to find
the extension when installed at `_extensions/<org>/<name>/`.
Workarounds: render project-wide (`quarto render`), or flatten the
extension path to `_extensions/<name>/` for that project.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**Typst PDF requires the bundled TTFs.** The extension ships
static-weight Atkinson Hyperlegible Next + Mono TTFs under
`_extensions/pequod/fonts/`. If you remove that directory, Typst
falls back to its built-in defaults (Libertinus Serif + DejaVu Sans
Mono) and the visual identity collapses.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**`pequod-html` dark mode requires `theme-toggle: true`.** Set it in
your project's `_quarto.yml` to surface the navbar control that flips
between the light and dark stylesheets:

```yaml
format:
  pequod-html:
    theme-toggle: true
```
:::
